/* SQL_ID: LN.CustomerContact.selectList */ SELECT c.CONTACT_ID AS contactId, c.CUSTOMER_NO AS customerNo, c.CONTACT_TYPE AS contactType, c.CONTACT_VALUE AS contactValue, c.USE_YN AS useYn, c.REG_DTM AS regDtm, c.UPD_DTM AS updDtm FROM LN_CUSTOMER_CONTACT c
ORDER BY c.UPD_DTM DESC, c.CONTACT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

/* SQL_ID: LN.CustomerContact.selectDetail */ SELECT c.CONTACT_ID AS contactId, c.CUSTOMER_NO AS customerNo, c.CONTACT_TYPE AS contactType, c.CONTACT_VALUE AS contactValue, c.USE_YN AS useYn, c.REG_DTM AS regDtm, c.UPD_DTM AS updDtm FROM LN_CUSTOMER_CONTACT c WHERE c.CONTACT_ID = #{contactId}
